title: anvil-allow escape format and where it must go
what: An intentional exception to a Tier 0 rule must be written as `anvil-allow(<rule>): <reason> [<ref>]`, inside a real comment, on the flagged line or the line just above it. Example: `// anvil-allow(no-swallowed-errors): cleanup is best effort [OPS-7]`. Escape hatches (@ts-ignore, eslint-disable, # noqa, #[allow], unsafe, PHP @, !important) are all reported under the single id no-escape-hatches.
why: Bare comments such as "// ignore" are not accepted, and the reported rule id differs from the per-kind names.
learned: The reason and a bracketed ref are both required; `all` and the short rule name also match.
author: reactive-end
